patch_description:
This edit upgrades the signal logic from a single-threshold liquidity filter into a regime-aware, asymmetric entry engine. It uses richer context already available in the bar data: short/medium order-book imbalance, volatility state, RSI extremes, Bollinger position, VWAP deviation, funding pressure, minutes-to-funding, and session flags.

The idea is to improve the combined score by:
- being more selective in low-quality conditions,
- allowing larger/earlier long entries when momentum and microstructure align,
- requiring stronger confirmation for shorts during squeezes or bullish funding regimes,
- sizing positions with confidence and volatility adjustment,
- widening or tightening TP/SL dynamically based on regime strength,
- extending hold time only when trend persistence supports it.

This keeps the implementation fully self-contained and avoids lookahead or external dependencies.
